calculate_maximum_value: calculate the maximum value by choosing addition or multiplication between consecutive digits in a string
run_f_gold: run f_gold on a digit string to compute the maximum value using plus or multiply operators
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using a set of digit string parameters and compare results
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace ord-based digit conversion with int() for clearer digit parsing
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which greedily adds digits 0, 1 or when result is below 2, otherwise multiplies
